featured_reviews.name: Joseph Nunes
featured_reviews.review_text:
St. Bonaventure Church in Madh Island (Erangal village) is one of Mumbai’s most serene and historically rich spiritual landmarks. Dating back to the 16th century, this church was built by the Portuguese Franciscans, and its age and simplicity give it a unique charm rarely found in the city’s fast-paced landscape.

The church sits right next to the beach—so close that the front almost touches the sand—making the surroundings incredibly peaceful, calm, tranquil, and soothing, with the gentle sound of waves and birds enhancing the overall experience. The architecture is simple but beautiful, featuring a classic façade, high ceilings, and a dome at the altar.

St. Bonaventure Church is among the oldest churches in Mumbai, with some accounts noting that it was built in 1575 and has stood for over 450 years. Its deep-rooted history makes it a significant heritage site for locals and visitors alike.

The church comes alive every year on 6th January during the Feast of Erangal, when thousands gather for Mass followed by a vibrant fair right next to the beach. The event blends spirituality, culture, and community spirit in a truly memorable way.

The Church feels peaceful and restorative. The narrow village lanes leading to it add to its hidden‑gem appeal. The interior is usually accessible through a caretaker, and stepping inside offers a deep sense of calm and reflection.

St. Bonaventure Church is perfect for anyone seeking serenity, history, and natural beauty. Whether you’re a pilgrim, a history lover, or someone who enjoys peaceful coastal spots, this church is absolutely worth a visit

For a quiet spiritual retreat away from the city
To experience one of Mumbai’s oldest surviving churches
To enjoy scenic beachside views
To attend the lively annual feast in January

featured_reviews.name: Jasmine Johnson
featured_reviews.review_text: When I found there is a Marthoma Church so close to my house after 3 yrs of living near it I was so happy & I went there few months back to enquire about the church timings but the way I was treated by the watchman I would suggest never ever go there. it's a place of worship not anyone's private property.. everyone has the right to visit the Church & what if it's a Malayalee Church aren't people from another belief and community accepted here? Is this how u train ur gaurds to treat another people who show interest to come and pray?? While u preach for heaven ?double standard huh? I was stopping myself from posting this here but every Sunday I miss the service and this Marthoma Church will be responsible for it..

featured_reviews.name: Rajesh Padmanabhan
featured_reviews.review_text: This is a Landmark in the four bungalows main street. A legacy structure which is majestic and radiates positive energy. Brings people of all communities together and we in the locality are blessed with the divine intervention. Beautifully maintained and well kept. Looks glorious during Christmas with colourful lights.

featured_reviews.name: Savvy Bajaj
featured_reviews.review_text:
Any place of worship is beautiful. . Just wanted to share I am a hindu, and I love coming to this local church in our residential  area which displays a sense of oneness towards all members.  This picture is of the Annual summer camp  it hosts with the youth of the church coming together to welcome and  embrace children from all walks of lives under its roof.

The fact that these  youths of today are spending quality time with the kids emulating  the finest details of good living like sharing, team work, empathy, leading and even humility is a great initiative. We are blessed to have goodness in our lives.

featured_reviews.name: Lavina Lobo
featured_reviews.review_text: I am a parishioner of this beautiful Good Shepherd Church, and am glad to contribute by using my talent singing in the choir. Happy to share my latest contribution to add to it’s beauty by painting this stained glass effect for the grotto. It is an honour to execute this request and grateful for the opportunity 🙏🏽❤️

featured_reviews.name: Celestine D'souza
featured_reviews.review_text: It's close to the metro and very accessible to everyone. The church lawns (ground) is really beautiful and can hold around 300-400 people. It's given out for occasions and is perfect for marriage functions. The community is very vibrant and active. It's worth visiting the church during Christmas time. The star and cribs are wow.

featured_reviews.name: Joshua Mendes
featured_reviews.review_text: Lovely place to visit with a peaceful ambience. The Church ground is also serene and mild away from the hustle bustle of the city crowd. Good place for a wedding or any other celebration.

featured_reviews.name: Sanket Humane
featured_reviews.review_text:
This is very nice church. It is located amidst a very nice residential area in Versova. There are many trees surrounding the church. Also though it is located adjacent to the busy street there is silence in the church premises.
It is a place of worship and also kept very neat and clean there are some stalls outside the church. Also there is a fish market nearby.
Very good place to visit.
